name: Soredemo, Watashi wa Aishiteiru
original_name: それでも、私は愛している
source: On a bright sunny day, a girl confesses to a boy on the school's rooftop. She's the class president. He's a delinquent. Will it work?
translation: On a bright sunny day, a girl confesses to a boy on the school's rooftop. She's the class president. He's a delinquent. Will it work?
